train_model_with_dataloaders: train a recommendation model using training and validation dataloaders with cosine scheduling and early stopping
evaluate_model_on_dataloader: evaluate a trained model on a dataloader and return metrics like NDCG and Recall at various K values
analyze_item_similarity_gaps: analyze the relationship between item token differences and prediction score gaps using case evaluation
evaluate_cold_start_performance: evaluate model performance on cold start items grouped by interaction history and return per-group metrics
save_model_checkpoint: save the best model checkpoint during training when validation score improves on the specified metric
